symptom.primary_diagnostic: fatal error: diary_render.hpp: No such file or directory

dynamic_evidence.first_materialization_fact: The initial Director native tool batch wrote both src/diary_cli.cpp and src/diary_render.cpp; both included diary_render.hpp, but the CE completion contract authorized no matching header artifact.
dynamic_evidence.ce_authority_fact: PM delegated C++ topology to Chief Engineer and required domain_modules, public_headers, and entrypoint. The CE interface contract declared invisible_ink::render_diary in src/diary_render.cpp without a public interface artifact.
dynamic_evidence.stage_local_retry_fact: The quality repair turn received the exact missing-header diagnostic and stayed in Director, but its immutable target scope contained the use-site only.

repair_coverage_probe.diagnostic: src/diary_cli.cpp:11:10: fatal error: diary_render.hpp: No such file or directory

root_causes.cause: Chief Engineer owned topology and promised public headers, but accepted a cross-file rendering provider implementation without projecting its required public interface artifact. Director therefore received an internally impossible completion contract before any code repair began.

Coverage metadata reported the C++ missing-header rule as executable, while the real planner returned no effect plan for the exact diagnostic and base file. The public result exposed planned=false with no error code, obscuring the non-executable boundary.

fixes.behavior: For a CE-delegated task that explicitly requires public_headers, project a missing same-stem C++ header only after at least two same-owner source/header pairs prove one unique layout. Entrypoints, ambiguous layouts, PM-owned topology, and unknown suffixes remain fail-closed.
A registered repair source tool that returns no effect plan now reports error_code=repair_not_planned instead of a silent false-green empty result.

verification.ce_portfolio_integration: exact completion contract contains include/invisible_ink/diary_render.hpp and excludes an entrypoint companion
verification.director_exact_red_green: repair_not_planned asserted for the exact r88 diagnostic

residual_risk: The header projection authorizes the missing interface artifact; the bound Director model must still materialize a valid declaration and implementation in a fresh run.
Coverage discovery remains metadata-oriented; the new public planning error prevents silence but does not yet make base-file-specific plannability part of the coverage report.
r88 was 28 production lines below the L3 depth contract, so a later fresh run may expose a separate depth residual after compilation advances.
